text:
maria: quick flag — running into a weird combo on the JS SDK in Deno/Bun: ESM import + fetch polyfill + auth retry seems to double-send requests. anyone seen this?
aj: seen something similar. can you paste the import error / stack?
maria: here's the minimal repro from our onboarding sample (deno):
```ts
import Redwood from 'redwood-inference'
// fails: "Cannot resolve package 'redwood-inference'" in deno deploy/runtime
```
maria: next we tried explicit url import to the published ESM bundle and ended up with runtime error when the auth token refreshed — request retried but headers missing, backend saw two attempts.
aj: hmm. sounds like two separate problems: 1) module resolution in Deno/Bun for our packaging, 2) retry middleware not preserving auth header on replay.
nate: for Deno you usually need a URL or a compat layer. we ship a cjs/esm dual package but deno expects single-file ESM or an import map. could the bundler publish miss the "exports" field for deno-friendly entry?
lina: yup — also bun's resolver is aggressive about package.json conditional exports. it will pick a different entrypoint than node. sometimes types end up pointing to a cjs file which errors in bun.
maria: how actionable — should sample app include a tiny shim? e.g. add this import in deno: `import fetch from 'node-fetch'; globalThis.fetch = fetch;` — but that's gross.
aj: UX-wise we should add an "edge"/"deno" entrypoint in the package that is pure ESM and uses webcrypto / fetch native APIs. then sample apps can import like: `import {Client} from 'redwood-inference/deno'`.
oliver: to the retry issue — our retry layer uses a cloned Request object for node-fetch but in browsers/deno we pass a plain object. cloning loses the Authorization header because we recreate the headers incorrectly. fix is to deep clone headers and any non-stream body before retry.
maria: repro stack trace: `TypeError: Cannot read property 'get' of undefined at retry (auth.ts:45)` — looks like headers became undefined.
aj: probable fix: when building retry we check if request.headers is a Headers instance, else wrap it: `const headers = new Headers(request.headers || {});` and then reattach to the retried request. also preserve body as `request.clone()` when present.
lina: note for deno: Request.clone isn't available in some runtime versions. we might need to fallback to reading body as arrayBuffer then reuse. small util in sdk: `reuseableRequest(req)` that returns {init, url} for constructing a new Request.
maria: I can open a small PR to the sample repo with a patch for the deno/bun sample and a README note about import map / url import. would that help reduce onboarding friction?
aj: yes please. also add a short section in quickstart: "Deno/Bun gotchas" with exact package import suggestion and a snippet that polyfills webcrypto if missing: `globalThis.crypto ||= require('node:crypto').webcrypto` (or the Deno equivalent).
nate: might be worth publishing a tiny SDK sub-entry `redwood-inference/dist/deno.mjs` built with esbuild targeting deno. build step in our pipeline can output that artifact.
devx-bot: CI: sample-app-deno build failed on linux-latest — see https://ci.internal/12345 for logs.
oliver: thanks — that CI link matches the bug where our deno sample CI used node-targeted artifact. I'll queue a patch to the build matrix to produce deno friendly bundle and add a test that runs the sample in bun/deno docker images.
lina: typing note: some users hit TS errors because our types export `Client` as CommonJS default. we should switch to `export default` in ESM type declaration and add `types/deno.d.ts` to the deno entry.
maria: ok I'll draft the PR: 1) sample patch with import/workaround 2) SDK change: retry header clone + deno entrypoint build 3) docs blurb.
aj: assign to @maria, @oliver for build changes, @lina for types, @nate for infra. please reference the CI failure in the PR description.
maria: thanks — will send a draft in ~2 hrs. ping me if you want to pair on the header cloning code. :thumbsup:
aj: thanks, will review.
